LESSON: CARING FOR PLANTS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the
Topic 3.1: Caring for plants environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Caring for plants environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. create appropriate plant protection messages to promote conservation
2. appreciate plant protection for environmental sustainability. protection messages using hand scripts, electronic and print resources protection messages with the school community songs on plant protection.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. create appropriate plant protection messages to promote conservation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create appropriate plant protection messages to promote conservation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate plant protection for environmental sustainability. protection messages using hand scripts, electronic and print resources protection messages with the school community songs on plant protection.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate plant protection for environmental sustainability. protection messages using hand scripts, electronic and print resources protection messages with the school community songs on plant protection. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Caring for plants environment.
2. Explain Caring for plants environment to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Caring for plants environment.
4. Show that you can: create appropriate plant protection messages to promote conservation
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Caring for plants environment. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Caring for plants environment important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. create appropriate plant protection messages to promote conservation
2. appreciate plant protection for environmental sustainability. protection messages using hand scripts, electronic and print resources protection messages with the school community songs on plant protection.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
